qco.title: Hallmarking of Gold Jewellery and Gold Artefacts Order, 2020
qco.scope: Mandatory hallmarking in notified districts under Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, S.O. 322(E), enforcing certified fineness grades under IS 1417.
exemptions: Export jewellery, medical artefacts, and manufacturers below threshold turnover are exempt.
requirements: Registration with BIS for gold jewellery retailing.
Assaying and hallmarking exclusively at BIS-recognized Assaying and Hallmarking Centres (AHC).
Mandatory 6-digit alphanumeric HUID (Hallmark Unique Identification) stamped alongside BIS logo and purity grade.
